angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 591,345 km at 159.62 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.2648 +/- 0.0111 mas (same row, RUWE 0.88): 159.62 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.85 +/- 0.05 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TrES-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 591,345 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.04 +/- 0.19 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TrES-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5230 +/- 50 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TrES-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TrES-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/tres-1.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.596, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-1 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 V, from Alonso et al. 2004 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2004ApJ...613L.153A/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-1 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.02 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-1 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.30071, from Baluev et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015MNRAS.450.3101B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-1 (pscomppars): age 3.7 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-1 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.3 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
